title: Sunshine Day Bar at Hollywood Studios | Walt Disney World | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Sunshine Day Bar Located in Sunset Boulevard at Disney's Hollywood Studios Brighten your day with refreshing sips along Sunset Boulevard. Enjoy a specialty cocktail or a crisp draft beer where the drinks are cold and the vibes are sunny!View Menu American Quick Service Restaurant Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM Valid admission required.
